apr.notes: 0% introductory APR on purchases for the first 12 billing cycles, then 16.99% to 27.99% variable. Balance transfer fee 5% ($5 min).

base_rate.description: Unlimited 2 points (2% cash back) per $1 on every purchase.

categories.label: Prepaid hotels and car rentals booked directly in the Travel Center
Business Essentials Earning Bonus with qualifying U.S. Bank business checking balances (first $10,000 in net purchases each billing cycle)

rewards.redemption_notes: Points redeem as cash back by deposit to an eligible U.S. Bank account or statement credit; other redemptions may be at a reduced rate.

signup_bonus.description: 50,000 bonus points (worth up to $500) after $5,000 in eligible net purchases within 150 days of account opening.

notes: The page names the card a Visa card without a Visa Signature or other package, so network_tier is none.
